mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS statDate, COUNT(*) AS callCount, SUM(prompt_tokens) AS promptTokens, SUM(completion_tokens) AS completionTokens, SUM(total_tokens) AS totalTokens, SUM(cost) AS totalCost, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successCount FROM t_call_log WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY statDate ASC

SELECT channel_id AS channelId, channel_name AS channelName, COUNT(*) AS totalRequests, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successRequests, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failRequests, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN total_tokens ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalTokens, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN cost ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalCost, ROUND(AVG(duration_ms)) AS avgDurationMs FROM t_call_log
DATE(created_at) = CURDATE()
created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} - 1 DAY)
GROUP BY channel_id, channel_name ORDER BY totalRequests DESC

SELECT u.id AS userId, u.username AS username, COUNT(l.id) AS totalRequests, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successRequests, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failRequests, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 1 THEN l.total_tokens ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalTokens, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 1 THEN l.cost ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalCost, ROUND(AVG(l.duration_ms)) AS avgDurationMs FROM t_user u LEFT JOIN t_call_log l ON l.user_id = u.id
AND DATE(l.created_at) = CURDATE()
AND l.created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} - 1 DAY)
WHERE u.deleted = 0 GROUP BY u.id, u.username ORDER BY totalTokens DESC, totalRequests DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(l.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS statDate, COUNT(*) AS callCount, SUM(l.prompt_tokens) AS promptTokens, SUM(l.completion_tokens) AS completionTokens, SUM(l.total_tokens) AS totalTokens, SUM(l.cost) AS totalCost, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successCount FROM t_call_log l JOIN t_user u ON l.user_id = u.id AND u.group_status = 0 AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE l.created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(l.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY statDate ASC

SELECT channel_id AS channelId, channel_name AS channelName, IFNULL(ROUND(SUM(cost), 6), 0) AS totalCost FROM t_call_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1 AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY channel_id, channel_name ORDER BY totalCost DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS statDate, IFNULL(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS totalTokens, IFNULL(ROUND(SUM(cost), 6), 0) AS totalCost FROM t_call_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1 AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY statDate ASC
